% \venn{<left set>}{<right set>}{<left only>}{<both>}{<right only>}{<outside>}
% The last argument is drawn as it stands, to place the outside
% region's contents anywhere around the circles.
\newcommand{\venn}[6]{%
  \begin{tikzpicture}[x=1mm,y=1mm]
    \draw (0,0) rectangle (66,34);
    \node[anchor=north west] at (0,34) {$\xi$};
    \draw (24,17) circle (13.5);
    \draw (42,17) circle (13.5);
    \node at (10,30) {$#1$};
    \node at (56,30) {$#2$};
    \node[align=center] at (17.5,17) {#3};
    \node[align=center] at (33,17) {#4};
    \node[align=center] at (48.5,17) {#5};
    #6
  \end{tikzpicture}}

% \freqtree{<total>}{<group>}{<n>}{<group>}{<n>}{<leaf>}{<leaf>}{<leaf>}{<leaf>}
% A frequency tree drawn left to right. The two outcomes on the right
% hand branches are named by \leafa and \leafb.
\newcommand{\leafa}{}
\newcommand{\leafb}{}
\newcommand{\freqtree}[9]{%
  \begin{tikzpicture}[x=1mm,y=1mm,
      box/.style={draw,minimum width=9mm,minimum height=5.5mm,inner sep=1pt},
      lab/.style={font=\small,inner sep=1pt}]
    \node[box] (r) at (0,0) {#1};
    \node[box] (u) at (18,10) {#3};
    \node[lab,above] at (u.north) {#2};
    \node[box] (d) at (18,-10) {#5};
    \node[lab,below] at (d.south) {#4};
    \node[box] (uu) at (37,14.5) {#6};
    \node[box] (ud) at (37,5.5) {#7};
    \node[box] (du) at (37,-5.5) {#8};
    \node[box] (dd) at (37,-14.5) {#9};
    \foreach \n in {uu,du}{\node[lab,right] at (\n.east) {\leafa};}
    \foreach \n in {ud,dd}{\node[lab,right] at (\n.east) {\leafb};}
    \draw (r.east) -- (u.west) (r.east) -- (d.west);
    \draw (u.east) -- (uu.west) (u.east) -- (ud.west);
    \draw (d.east) -- (du.west) (d.east) -- (dd.west);
  \end{tikzpicture}}

\usepackage{xcolor}

\definecolor{ealkeycolour}{RGB}{0,128,0}
\definecolor{ealenglish}{RGB}{0,0,0}
\definecolor{ealtwocolour}{RGB}{112,48,160}

\newsavebox{\ealboxen}
\newsavebox{\ealboxtr}
\newlength{\ealglosswd}
\newlength{\ealglossraise}
\setlength{\ealglossraise}{1.15em}

% a tier 3 word, in English and in translation alike
\newcommand{\ealkey}[1]{\textcolor{ealkeycolour}{#1}}
\newcommand{\ealkeytr}[1]{\textcolor{ealkeycolour}{\ealtext{#1}}}

% One translated word above one English word. Built from kernel
% primitives, never a tabular, which would break wherever the sheet
% loads array, booktabs or tabularx. The box is as wide as the wider of
% the two, so a long translation pushes its neighbours aside instead of
% overlapping them, and it claims its full height so a table row or a
% TikZ node makes room for it.
\newcommand{\ealgloss}[2]{%
  \sbox{\ealboxen}{\ealkey{#1}}%
  \sbox{\ealboxtr}{\small\textcolor{ealtwocolour}{\ealtext{#2}}}%
  \setlength{\ealglosswd}{\wd\ealboxen}%
  \ifdim\wd\ealboxtr>\ealglosswd\setlength{\ealglosswd}{\wd\ealboxtr}\fi
  \leavevmode
  \makebox[\ealglosswd][c]{%
    \makebox[0pt][c]{\usebox{\ealboxen}}%
    \makebox[0pt][c]{\raisebox{\ealglossraise}{\usebox{\ealboxtr}}}%
  }%
}

% opens up line spacing around a block of glosses, so the raised
% translations sit clear of the line above
\newenvironment{ealglossed}{\par\linespread{2.1}\selectfont\ignorespaces}{\par}

% a whole translated sentence above its English counterpart. block level,
% so it does not belong inside a tabular cell
\newcommand{\ealpara}[2]{%
  \par\addvspace{0.5\baselineskip}%
  {\color{ealtwocolour}\ealtextblock{#1}}%
  \penalty200
  {\color{ealenglish}#2\par}%
  \addvspace{0.5\baselineskip}%
}

% ----------------------------------------------------------------
\ealpara{Escrever \ealkeytr{probabilidades} como \ealkeytr{frações}, \ealkeytr{decimais} e \ealkeytr{percentagens}}{\topic{Writing \ealkey{probabilities} as \ealkey{fractions}, \ealkey{decimals} and \ealkey{percentages}}}
\ealpara{Um saco tem 4 rebuçados verdes (G), 6 amarelos (Y) e 10 brancos (W). Tira-se um rebuçado de forma \ealkeytr{aleatória}. Escreve P(green) como uma \ealkeytr{fração}, um \ealkeytr{decimal} e uma \ealkeytr{percentagem}.}{\q A bag holds 4 green (G), 6 yellow (Y) and 10 white (W) sweets. One sweet is taken at \ealkey{random}. Write P(green) as a \ealkey{fraction}, a \ealkey{decimal} and a \ealkey{percentage}.}\vspace{4pt}
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1mm,y=1mm]
  \draw[rounded corners=4mm] (0,0) rectangle (58,24);
  \draw (6,24) -- (10,28) -- (48,28) -- (52,24);
  \foreach \l [count=\i from 0] in {G,Y,W,W,G,Y,W,Y,W,W,Y,G,W,Y,W,G,W,Y,W,W}{
    \pgfmathtruncatemacro{\r}{\i/7}
    \pgfmathtruncatemacro{\c}{mod(\i,7)}
    \draw (7+\c*7.4,19-\r*7) circle (2.8);
    \node[font=\small] at (7+\c*7.4,19-\r*7) {\l};}
\end{tikzpicture}
\ealpara{A \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de um comboio se atrasar é 0.12. Qual é a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de ele não se atrasar?}{\q The \ealkey{probability} that a train is late is 0.12. What is the \ealkey{probability} that it is not late?}
\ealpara{A tabela mostra as \ealkeytr{probabilidades} de um spinner sair em cada cor. Encontra a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de sair amarelo.}{\q The table shows the \ealkey{probabilities} of a spinner landing on each colour. Find the \ealkey{probability} that it lands on yellow.}\vspace{4pt}
{\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.5}%
\begin{tabular}{|l|c|c|c|c|}\hline
Colour & Red & Blue & Green & Yellow\\\hline
\ealkey{Probability} & 0.3 & 0.25 & 0.15 & \\\hline
\end{tabular}}

% ----------------------------------------------------------------
\ealpara{Listar \ealkeytr{resultados} de forma sistemática}{\topic{Listing \ealkey{outcomes} systematically}}
\ealpara{Um café vende três entradas: sopa (S), melão (M) e camarões (P). Vende dois pratos principais: peixe (F) e caril (C). Lista todas as refeições possíveis com uma entrada e um prato principal.}{\q A caf\'e sells three starters: soup (S), melon (M) and prawns (P). It sells two mains: fish (F) and curry (C). List all the possible meals of one starter and one main.}
\ealpara{O spinner A tem os números 1, 2, 3, 4. O spinner B tem os números 1, 2, 3. Ambos os spinners são rodados, e as duas pontuações são multiplicadas.\\ (a) Copia e completa o \ealkeytr{diagrama do espaço amostral}.\\ (b) Encontra a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de a resposta ser \ealkeytr{par}.}{\q Spinner A is numbered 1, 2, 3, 4. Spinner B is numbered 1, 2, 3. Both spinners are spun, and the two scores are multiplied.\\ (a) Copy and complete the \ealkey{sample space diagram}.\\ (b) Find the \ealkey{probability} that the answer is \ealkey{even}.}\vspace{4pt}
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=9mm,y=6mm]
  \draw[step={(1,1)}] (0,-4) grid (4,1);
  \node at (0.5,0.5) {$\times$};
  \foreach \b in {1,2,3}{\node at (\b+0.5,0.5) {\textbf{\b}};}
  \foreach \a in {1,...,4}{\node at (0.5,-\a+0.5) {\textbf{\a}};}
  \foreach \b in {1,2,3}{\node at (\b+0.5,-0.5) {\b};}
  \node at (1.5,-1.5) {2};
  \node[above] at (2.5,1) {\small spinner B};
  \node[left] at (0,-2) {\small A};
\end{tikzpicture}

% ----------------------------------------------------------------
\ealpara{Resultados esperados}{\topic{Expected results}}
\ealpara{Uma moeda \ealkeytr{justa} é lançada 300 vezes. Quantas caras esperarias?}{\q A \ealkey{fair} coin is flipped 300 times. How many heads would you expect?}
\ealpara{A \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de um autocarro se atrasar é 0.08. Em quantas de 250 viagens esperarias que o autocarro se atrasasse?}{\q The \ealkey{probability} that a bus is late is 0.08. On how many of 250 journeys would you expect the bus to be late?}

% ----------------------------------------------------------------
\ealpara{\ealkeytr{Probabilidade experimental}}{\topic{\ealkey{Experimental probability}}}
\ealpara{Um dado é lançado 200 vezes. A tabela mostra os dados.}{\q A dice is rolled 200 times. The table shows the results.}\vspace{4pt}
{\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.5}%
\begin{tabular}{|l|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline
Score & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 & 5 & 6\\\hline
\ealkey{Frequency} & 31 & 35 & 30 & 36 & 33 & 35\\\hline
\end{tabular}}\vspace{4pt}
\ealpara{(a) Encontra a \ealkeytr{frequência relativa} de sair um 4.\\ (b) Os dados sugerem que o dado é \ealkeytr{justo}? Explica a tua resposta.}{(a) Find the \ealkey{relative frequency} of rolling a 4.\\ (b) Do the results suggest that the dice is \ealkey{fair}? Explain your answer.}
\ealpara{A Jo lança uma moeda 20 vezes e obtém 14 caras. O Kai lança a mesma moeda 500 vezes e obtém 260 caras. Os dados de quem dão a melhor estimativa da \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de sair cara? Escreve essa estimativa.}{\q Jo flips a coin 20 times and gets 14 heads. Kai flips the same coin 500 times and gets 260 heads. Whose results give the better estimate of the \ealkey{probability} of heads? Write down this estimate.}

% ----------------------------------------------------------------
\ealpara{\ealkeytr{Árvores de frequências}}{\topic{\ealkey{Frequency trees}}}
\ealpara{120 pessoas visitaram um museu. 70 delas eram adultos. 45 dos adultos compraram um guia. 20 das crianças compraram um guia.\\ (a) Copia e completa a \ealkeytr{árvore de frequências}.\\ (b) Um visitante é escolhido de forma \ealkeytr{aleatória}. Encontra a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de ele ter comprado um guia.}{\q 120 people visited a museum. 70 of them were adults. 45 of the adults bought a guidebook. 20 of the children bought a guidebook.\\ (a) Copy and complete the \ealkey{frequency tree}.\\ (b) A visitor is chosen at \ealkey{random}. Find the \ealkey{probability} that they bought a guidebook.}\vspace{4pt}
{\renewcommand{\leafa}{Book}\renewcommand{\leafb}{No book}%
\freqtree{120}{Adults}{}{Children}{}{}{}{}{}}

\end{multicols}

\ealpara{\ealkeytr{Diagramas de Venn}}{\topic{\ealkey{Venn diagrams}}}
\ealpara{Há 50 alunos num ano. 28 estudam Francês (F), 19 estudam Espanhol (S), e 8 estudam ambos.\\ (a) Copia e completa o \ealkeytr{diagrama de Venn}.\\ (b) Um aluno é escolhido de forma \ealkeytr{aleatória}. Encontra a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de ele não estudar nenhuma das línguas.}{\q There are 50 pupils in a year group. 28 study French (F), 19 study Spanish (S), and 8 study both.\\ (a) Copy and complete the \ealkey{Venn diagram}.\\ (b) A pupil is chosen at \ealkey{random}. Find the \ealkey{probability} that they study neither language.}\vspace{4pt}
\venn{F}{S}{}{}{}{}
\ealpara{O \ealkeytr{diagrama de Venn} mostra os números de 1 a 15. A é o conjunto dos números \ealkeytr{pares} e B é o conjunto dos \ealkeytr{quadrados perfeitos}. Um dos números é escolhido de forma \ealkeytr{aleatória}. Encontra\\ (a) P($A\cap B$), a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de estar em A e B\\ (b) P($A\cup B$), a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de estar em A ou B ou em ambos\\ (c) P($A'$), a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de não estar em A.}{\q The \ealkey{Venn diagram} shows the numbers from 1 to 15. A is the \ealkey{even} numbers and B is the \ealkey{square numbers}. One of the numbers is chosen at \ealkey{random}. Find\\ (a) P($A\cap B$), the \ealkey{probability} that it is in A and B\\ (b) P($A\cup B$), the \ealkey{probability} that it is in A or B or both\\ (c) P($A'$), the \ealkey{probability} that it is not in A.}\vspace{4pt}
\venn{A}{B}{\hspace*{2mm}2\enspace 6\\[1pt]\hspace*{2mm}8\enspace 10\\[1pt]\hspace*{2mm}12\enspace 14}{4}{1\\[2pt]9}%
  {\node at (4,17) {3}; \node at (62,17) {5}; \node at (4,4) {7}; \node at (62,4) {11};
   \node at (33,31.3) {13}; \node at (33,2.7) {15};}

% ----------------------------------------------------------------
\ealpara{\ealkeytr{Probabilidade condicional} com \ealkeytr{diagramas de Venn}}{\topic{\ealkey{Conditional probability} with \ealkey{Venn diagrams}}}
\ealpara{O \ealkeytr{diagrama de Venn} mostra 60 pessoas, e se têm um gato (C) ou um cão (D).}{\q The \ealkey{Venn diagram} shows 60 people, and whether they own a cat (C) or a dog (D).}\vspace{4pt}
\venn{C}{D}{14}{10}{21}{\node at (60,4) {15};}\vspace{2pt}
\ealpara{(a) Encontra a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de uma pessoa escolhida de forma \ealkeytr{aleatória} ter um cão.\\ (b) \ealkeytr{Dado que} uma pessoa tem um cão, encontra a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de ela também ter um gato.}{(a) Find the \ealkey{probability} that a person chosen at \ealkey{random} owns a dog.\\ (b) \ealkey{Given} that a person owns a dog, find the \ealkey{probability} that they also own a cat.}
\ealpara{Usa o teu \ealkeytr{diagrama de Venn} da pergunta 11. \ealkeytr{Dado que} um aluno estuda Francês, encontra a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de ele também estudar Espanhol.}{\q Use your \ealkey{Venn diagram} from question 11. \ealkey{Given} that a pupil studies French, find the \ealkey{probability} that they also study Spanish.}

\ealpara{Resolução de problemas}{\topic{Problem solving}}
\ealpara{Um saco tem contadores vermelhos e azuis na \ealkeytr{razão} $3:5$. São colocados mais dois contadores vermelhos no saco. Agora a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de tirar um contador vermelho é $\frac12$. Quantos contadores havia no saco no início?}{\q A bag holds red and blue counters in the \ealkey{ratio} $3:5$. Two more red counters are put in the bag. Now the \ealkey{probability} of taking a red counter is $\frac12$. How many counters were in the bag at the start?}
\ealpara{Um spinner tem 5 secções iguais, cada uma colorida de vermelho, azul ou verde. A \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de sair vermelho é 0.4, e a \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de sair azul é o dobro da \ealkeytr{probabilidade} de sair verde. Desenha o spinner.}{\q A spinner has 5 equal sections, each coloured red, blue or green. The \ealkey{probability} of red is 0.4, and the \ealkey{probability} of blue is twice the \ealkey{probability} of green. Draw the spinner.}
\ealpara{O Sam lança um dado 6 vezes e nunca tira um 6. Ele diz: ``O dado deve ser \ealkeytr{enviesado}.'' O Sam tem razão? Explica a tua resposta.}{\q Sam rolls a dice 6 times and never gets a 6. He says, ``The dice must be \ealkey{biased}.'' Is Sam right? Explain your answer.}

\end{multicols}
